title: Paloma and the Cipher
author: X. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Marguerite Marchetti, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
